shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other. A woman in an orange shirt sits in the plant-side window seat and begins telling a holiday story, while a woman in a blue shirt sits in the plant-side aisle seat and a woman in a yellow shirt sits in the counter-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the counter end, looking lengthwise along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: A man in a white shirt enters and sits in the counter-side window seat. He asks about the holiday destination, and the woman in an orange shirt answers.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a yellow shirt interrupts with a question about the itinerary, and the woman in an orange shirt replies.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the plant end, looking lengthwise along the rectangular table toward the café counter, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
